timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: The plan changed and I do not like it.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I had already prepared for something different.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I feel disappointed and thrown off.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: My mind keeps returning to how it was supposed to go.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is resisting this sudden change.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I want the original plan back.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me feels like the whole day is ruined.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that I feel frustrated.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: It is hard to shift gears this quickly.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can honor the disappointment and still adjust.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: The original plan mattered to me.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can release what is no longer available.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I do not have to like the change to meet it.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can find a new rhythm.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can ask what I need now.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: A changed plan does not have to ruin the whole day.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can give myself time to transition.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can begin finding my footing again.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can meet this version of the day.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I am allowed to create a new plan.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I trust myself to adapt without rushing.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can notice what is still possible.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can settle into the change.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can carry flexibility without abandoning my needs.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: This moment can unfold differently and still be okay.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I choose the next available step.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to move with what is here.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
